# Tone Adjust map — RACK encoders and sliders (Kronos Kontrol 1.0f)

*Generated by `panels/KronosKontrol/sources/ta_values.py --refresh` ; machine-readable copy : `data/tone_adjust_map.json`. Everything needed to read, show and send the 8 encoders and 9 sliders is here : no need to open kronos-pcglib.*

## 0. The controls on the Main panel

The Main panel is the same in the CtrlrX VST3 / exe and in the Ableton device, and works the same way (the CtrlrX build adds the EDITOR). Artwork : `graphics/KRONOS_Main` (generator `sources_Main/kt.py`) ; copy for the Ableton device : `ableton-panel/reference/Main_1.0f_2026-11-03`.

| Control | Layout id | Panel (CtrlrX) | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| 8 encoders | `encoders_1`…`_8` | `kkEnc01`…`08`, labels `kkEncL01`…`08` | Tone Adjust encoders 1-8 |
| 9 sliders | `sliders_1`…`_9` | `kkFdr1`…`9`, screens `kkFdrL1`…`9` | Tone Adjust sliders 1-8 + Master (label only in Program mode) |
| EXi1 / EXi2 (above SW2 / HOLD) | `exi_exi1`, `exi_exi2` | `kkBtnEXI1/2`, lit `kkLitEXI1/2`, dim `kkExiMask1/2` | engine edited in Program mode |
| TIMBRE SELECT screen (popup 1-16) | `timbre_menu1` | `kkTimbre` (callback `kkTimbreMenu`), dim `kkTimbreMask` | timbre edited in Combi mode |
| titles TIMBRE SELECT, TONE ADJUST CONTROLS | — | artwork | — |

Lua : `lua/kkMain.lua` (`kkTaCtx`, `kkTaTrack`, `kkTaSend`) ; tables `KK_LAY` / `KK_LAYX` / `KK_LAYV` / `KK_TARNG` (method `kkTaValues`, from the JSON) ; factory slots without bytes : `KRONOS_DATA.tav` (16 positions + EXi + 2 EP-1 selector bytes), `tav2` (two-EXi programs : EXi 2 engine + 16 positions + 2 bytes), `tat` (combis : 37-byte blocks per active timbre : timbre, EXi 1 / EXi 2 engines, 17 assigns, 17 positions ; 255 = none), built by `scripts/gen_data_lua.py`.

## 1. What the controls do

- **PROGRAM mode.** Encoder *i* = layout slot *i*-1, slider *i* = layout slot 7+*i* of the engine selected with **EXi1 / EXi2** (an HD-1 program has one layout ; both EXi buttons are off). Moving a control sends a **Parameter Change** (function 43) to that engine : `F0 42 3g 68 43 TYP SOC SUB PID IDX vH vM vL F7`, value = 21-bit two's complement (`vH` = bits 14-20). For an EXi engine **TYP = 11 for EXi 1, 12 for EXi 2**. Slider 9 (Master) has no layout slot : label only, nothing sent. A slot without a single stored parameter keeps the former CC (encoders : CC 74, 71, 79, 72, 17, 19, 20, 21 ; sliders : CC 76, 77, 16, 5, 73, 75, 70, 72).
- **COMBI mode.** The 17 controls are the **Tone Adjust of the timbre selected in TIMBRE (1-16)**, as stored in the combi. Moving a control sends `TYP 28, SOC = timbre - 1, SUB 0, PID 5 (encoder) / 4 (slider), IDX = 0-7 (Master slider = 8)`, value inside the range of its assign code (section 4). EXi1 / EXi2 are off in Combi mode : each timbre control already targets EXi 1 or 2 through bit 7 of its assign byte.
- **Slider 9 (Master)** : in Tone Adjust it is not a master control but a ninth assignable slider (« Slider M ») ; what it does depends on each program’s **Master Fader Assign** (0-based 2682 ; code = byte & 0x7F, bit 7 = EXi 2). Program mode : its label is that code’s name ; when the code edits one stored parameter (section 4b) it shows the stored value and a move sends that parameter (TYP 11 / 12 by EXi) ; a code without one is label only (64). Combi mode : the timbre’s Master Fader assign / value (TYP 28, PID 4, IDX 8).
- **Assigned Off** (any control with assign code 0 : Program slider 9, combi timbre controls) : no effect on the sound -> position **0** and « - » (maintainer, 3 Nov 2026 : a control that does nothing sits at 0 ; once the user assigns it and saves, the stored value is read).
- **No data** (GM / g banks, no PCG, no dump) or an assigned control without a readable value : position **64** (centre).
- Values are set without sending anything ; a user move is kept until the selection, the EXi, the timbre or the bytes change.

## 2. Reading a value

- **Field** = list of bit pieces `(offset, low bit, high bit)`, offsets 0-based in the object (program 4960 B, combi 7810 B), first piece = low bits. `value = Σ ((byte[offset] >> low) & (2^w - 1)) << shift`.
- **Position** 0-127 = `round(clamp(((value - RawMin) mod 2^bits) / RawRange, 0, 1) × 127)`.
- **Sent value** = `vlo + round(position / 127 × RawRange)`, `vlo` = RawMin as a signed number (RawMin − 2^bits when RawMin + RawRange ≥ 2^bits).
- **Engines of a program** : oscillator mode = byte 2558 & 7 (3 = EXi) ; EXi 1 engine = byte 2857, EXi 2 = byte 3909 (2 AL-1, 3 CX-3, 4 STR-1, 5 MS-20EX, 6 PolysixEX, 7 MOD-7, 8 SGX-2, 9 EP-1 ; other = off). EXi engine block : EXi 1 = 2908, EXi 2 = 3960 (the offsets below already include it).
- **EP-1** : some slots depend on the model (`(byte[block] >> 7) | ((byte[block+1] & 3) << 1)`) or on the insert effect (`(byte[block+1] >> 2) & 0x0F`) — section 5.
- **Combi timbre t (1-16)** : base = 4802 + 188 (t − 1) ; program = byte base, bank = byte base+1, status = byte base+2 >> 5 (0 = Off). Encoder k assign = base + 54 + 4 (k−1), slider k = base + 150 + 4 (k−1), Master = base + 182 ; the value is the signed 16-bit little-endian word 2 bytes after its assign. Assign code = byte & 0x7F, bit 7 set = the parameter of EXi 2. Position = `(value − lo) / (hi − lo) × 127` with the range of section 4.

## 3. Layouts per engine

Columns : slot, control, label, field `[offset, low, high]…`, RawMin / RawRange, Parameter Change `TYP SOC SUB PID IDX`, signed range sent. « — » = no stored parameter (label only / former CC).

## 4b. Tone Adjust codes editing one stored parameter (Program slider 9)

From pcglib’s ToneAdjustTable field (its Parameter Change id on Korg’s row at the same offset / low bit), else a strict unique name match in Korg’s engine table (« [Section] Name » or « Name » or « Name Level » = the code’s name ; a field running over into the next byte takes that byte’s free low bits). Check : where a code is also an engine-layout slot, 35 of 36 fields agree ; the one difference is inside pcglib (STR-1 code 89 NOISE LVL : ToneAdjustTable 3287 / EngineLayoutTable 3393 — to settle on the KRONOS). Not resolvable (label only) : macros (Rel), fields depending on another setting (EP-1 IFX WET/DRY : per insert effect).
